minify_file: minify a single JSON file by encoding line_ids and rounding numeric fields using the Minifier transformer
minify: minify all JSON files in a folder in parallel using multiprocessing and write results to an output directory
fetch_metadata_file: fetch precomputed metadata for a single file by joining it with segment metadata from a metadata directory
fetch_metadata: fetch metadata for multiple files in parallel by joining each with precomputed segment metadata from a directory
encode_line_ids: encode a sequence of integer line IDs into a compact base64 string using little-endian unsigned 16-bit encoding
